additions.reason: The potential intellect (שכל בכח) is the first stage after the imagination has been broken (שמיר). The text explicitly names the three stages — שכל בכח, שכל בפועל, שכל הנקנה — as the triad that the Torah is organized around. שכל בכח is the state that emerges when the stone-heart is broken (Package 2's domain), before actualization through speech. It shares essential nature with the שמיר/breaking cluster since the text says 'the intellect is still in potential (כח) even after breaking the imagination, until it is used.'

additions.reason: Amanah is explicitly called a bechina of the acquired intellect (שכל הנקנה) which is the permanence/continuity of the person after death. The text says 'אמנה — לשון קיום דבר, כי שכל הנקנה הוא קיום של אדם לאחר מותו.' It belongs with the good intellectual domain. Since שמיר and breaking the stone-heart enable the intellect to develop toward the שכל הנקנה, Amanah as the endpoint of that journey belongs near Package 2 (the good intellectual enabling domain). additions.reason: The wall (כותל) is parsed as כ״ו-תל: כ״ו = the numerical value of the Divine Name (YHVH = 26), which is the bechina of the supernal colors/light ('ה' אורי'). 'תל' = the hub that all turn to. In the context of Torah #25, the כותל is the Divine Name-aspect that tears down/overcomes the imagination (המדמה) — the solution to the klipa at the gate. The text places כותל in the context of both inner structure (פנימיות domain) and Divine light (גונין domain). However, since the text explicitly derives it from 'שם הקדוש שהוא בחינת גונין,' it belongs in Package 3 (neutral structural framework) OR Package 5 (גונין). Given that the Zohar derivation 'כ״ו זה בחינת שם הקדוש, שהוא בחינת גונין' links it to the Divine light domain, Package 5 may be more appropriate, but the structural context (kise/kavod section of Torah 25) suggests Package 3 as its primary home.
